• After you're accepted, we'll message you your area or zip code. Each person gets a different area, so stick to yours.

• Craigslist charges a small fee to post in gigs. Pay it, then send us a screenshot of the charge or receipt in this chat, and we'll reimburse you ASAP on top of the $8.

"Sign holder needed: Thu Oct 8, 4:30–7pm, Pier 48 (Mission Bay). $50 for the shift. Stand near the event entrance holding a sign. The event team brings the sign and shows you your spot. Easy to reach from the T line or Caltrain at 4th & King. Reply to this ad for details and the link to apply."

Proof:
Steps 1 and 2 (for your posting-fee reimbursement):
1. A screenshot of your live ad that shows the Craigslist URL and the full ad text with no links in it, plus the posting URL pasted as text.
2. A screenshot of your Craigslist fee receipt.
Step 3 (for the rest of your payment):
3. Screenshots of every reply you sent to an applicant, showing their question and your answer with your Share & Earn link (if nobody wrote in, say so), plus a screenshot of your ad still live 48 hours after posting, or showing it was flagged or removed.

bounties.title: QA test: Home Management App – General UX & Impressions Review — 2026-10-01
bounties.description:
One-time QA test run for https://havenhomeapp.com/.

What to do:
You are testing a home management app. Please install it on your device and explore it thoroughly.

**What to test:**
Spend at least 10–15 minutes exploring the app. Go through onboarding, the main features, and any flows that seem central to the app's concept. Try to use the app as you naturally would if it were part of your daily routine managing your home.

**What to capture in your video:**
Record your full screen throughout the session. Please narrate your thoughts as you go — what you find intuitive, what confuses you, what you'd expect to find but can't. Silent video is also accepted but narration is strongly encouraged.

**Key questions to address:**
1. What is your overall first impression?
2. What works well and feels polished?
3. What does not work well, is confusing, or feels broken?
4. How clear is the core concept of the app — did you quickly understand what it's for?
5. What features feel missing or incomplete for someone managing their home?

Report any bugs with clear reproduction steps in your narration or as a note in your submission.

Deliverable:
- Test https://havenhomeapp.com/ following the instructions above.
- Send video evidence for every issue in the accepted tester chat.
- Record your screen and microphone audio for the full test. Narrate your actions, every error you find, and anything confusing, poor, or worth improving.
- Attach the narrated video as an MP4, MOV, or WebM no larger than 512 MB, plus at least one representative screenshot.
- For each issue include a short title, a severity (critical/high/medium/low), and exact steps to reproduce.
- Submissions are reviewed automatically. $10.00 is released per accepted submission.

Tester requirements:
- Homeowner or renter managing their own home (not living with parents)
- iOS or Android device able to install beta apps via TestFlight or Google Play beta

bounties.title: QA test: Orbit 0.2.19: full flow — 2026-09-18
bounties.description:
One-time QA test run for https://github.com/emma2bean-bot/orbit-releases/releases/tag/v0.2.19.

What to do:
Orbit is a small Mac menu-bar app that reads your Messages on your Mac (locally, nothing leaves your computer) and helps you keep up with friends you have not replied to. You need: a Mac with Apple silicon on macOS 14 or newer, Apple Messages set up on that Mac with real conversations, and permission to record your screen. Download Orbit.dmg from the page above, open it, drag Orbit to Applications, and open it from Applications. It is signed and notarized by Apple, so macOS will not block it. Record your screen with narration the whole time and say out loud what you expect versus what happens. Privacy: you may blur or skip showing message contents; we only need to see how Orbit behaves. When done, quit Orbit from its Settings and drag it to the Trash if you like.

THIS RUN: the full flow, start to finish, about 30 to 40 minutes. You have 6 hours from accepting, so start only when you have the time.
1. Install and launch. Walk through every setup screen. On the Full Disk Access step, click the button that opens System Settings and switch Orbit on; if macOS offers Quit & Reopen, choose Later. Does the setup window come back on its own?
2. Allow Contacts, Send through Messages (Automation), Notifications and Calendar when asked. After each Apple dialog closes, does the Orbit window come straight back? Note any step where Orbit seemed to disappear.
3. On 'Who do you want to keep up with?': read the ring legend (Inner, Close, Wider, New). In your own words, what does each ring do? Pick 5 to 15 people and give each a ring.
4. On 'Pick your notification times': read 'How a batch works' and tell us in your own words who gets a card and when. Set one time about 10 minutes from now.
5. Finish setup. IMPORTANT: when the setup window closes, does the Orbit popup open by itself from the menu bar? Yes or no, and what you saw.
6. On a card, type a short real reply in the box and press Send. You get 1.5 seconds to undo. Did the message really send (check Messages)? Did the next card come up right away? Any freeze or spinning wheel?
7. On another card press 'No reply needed'. Does the card's bottom button turn into Next, and does the card move on by itself after about a second? Try 'Later' on a third card.
8. If someone you replied to had an unread blue dot in Messages, open Messages afterwards: is the dot gone?
9. Open Orbit's Settings. Press 'Check for updates now' at the top: what does it say? Switch Appearance between System, Light and Dark: does everything change at once and stay readable?
10. Wait for the notification at your chosen time. Did a banner arrive, and does clicking it open Orbit on today's cards?
Report: a yes/no answer to every numbered item, a bug list with steps to reproduce, and the three most confusing sentences you saw, quoted, with how you would rewrite each.

Deliverable:
- Test https://github.com/emma2bean-bot/orbit-releases/releases/tag/v0.2.19 following the instructions above.
- Send video evidence for every issue in the accepted tester chat.
- Record your screen and microphone audio for the full test. Narrate your actions, every error you find, and anything confusing, poor, or worth improving.
- Attach the narrated video as an MP4, MOV, or WebM no larger than 512 MB, plus at least one representative screenshot.
- For each issue include a short title, a severity (critical/high/medium/low), and exact steps to reproduce.
- Submissions are reviewed automatically. $16.90 is released per accepted submission.

Tester requirements:
- Apple silicon Mac on macOS 14 or newer
- Apple Messages set up on that Mac with real conversations
- Can record screen with narration

Country restriction:
- Only testers with profile country in US, CA, GB, AU may apply.

Report every issue with a severity and exact reproduction steps
Only submit evidence you captured yourself during this run
